kitQa.reviewScope: All 60 paired top/oblique diagnostics visually inspected across four sheets against official kitting; units/physical rows, row slope, dish, F/J bars, stepped Caps, space convexity, legends and palette checked. Automated 120 image bounds + 60 texture bounds + actual material texture binding and finite UVs. Visualization-quality approval only, not exact retail mold certification.

visualQa.scope: Visually inspected all twelve actual-angle PNGs in three four-frame contact sheets and front full-frame. Consistent charcoal housing and three-tone purple NicePBT Purple Chonkers retail caps; no personal brand keys, no keyboard cropping, stable camera and geometry. Reviewed visible key profile including stepped Caps Lock, occlusion, side USB opening, rear plate/weight, feet, perforations, shadows and silhouette. Exact physical geometry, legends/fonts and filament color are approximate visualization, not fit or color certification. Frozen individual-key QA remains separate.

kitQa.reviewScope: All 60 PBTfans WOB PT04-1 selected retail caps rendered individually in top and oblique orthographic views, 120 PNGs total. Every pair visually inspected against the official Base Alpha+Text Modifiers atlas via four sheets (backslash pair also opened separately); all legends readable, correct orientation, no overlap/cropping, all-black supplemental Esc/Enter/arrows confirmed. Automated exact layout and texture/object alpha bounds pass. This is individual visualization QA only, not full-board or 12-angle combination QA.

visualQa.scope: Visually inspected all twelve actual-angle PNGs in three four-frame contact sheets and front full-frame. Consistent ice-blue housing and black white-legend PBTFans WOB retail caps; no personal brand keys, no keyboard cropping, stable camera and geometry. Reviewed visible key profile including stepped Caps Lock, occlusion, side USB opening, rear plate/weight, feet, perforations, shadows and silhouette. Exact physical geometry, legends/fonts and filament color are approximate visualization, not fit or color certification. Frozen individual-key QA remains separate.
